faq_heading: Homes near Frank Hurt Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Frank Hurt Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Frank Hurt Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Frank Hurt Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Frank Hurt Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Bear Creek Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Guru Angad Dev School (0.9 km west) and M B Sanford Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Frank Hurt Secondary

27 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Frank Hurt Secondary in a straight line (21 elementary, 3 other, 3 secondary; 5 independent). The closest is Bear Creek Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cindrich Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Enver Creek Secondary (1.9 km); the nearest independent school is Guru Angad Dev School (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (3.0 km). Other secondary schools close by: Enver Creek Secondary (1.9 km north-east), Princess Margaret Secondary (2.4 km south-west), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (3.0 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Enver Creek Secondary, 1.9 km north-east of Frank Hurt Secondary.
